response.overview: "To earth, they are saviors. To the algorithm, they are targets."  DAII, a revolutionary mobile app, turns real-life activity into gamified enlightenment. But behind its rewards lies a sinister cult algorithm quietly judging human worth. When the app selects its monthly "Daii"— individuals exposed to the public as anomalies—the chosen few become hunted by an obsessed populace desperate for cosmic answers. As the app relentlessly narrows the pool to a single and permanently chosen one, where they discovers that escaping the zealots is only the beginning.
response.title: Da'ee (داعي)
